Bail Organa's '''office''' was located in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. His apartment was also located here. His office was where he and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] spoke about the [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|bill]] to fund five million [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].
